# \faUser\ About me

I am a data scientist with a degree from the [School of Applied Mathematics](https://emap.fgv.br/en) (FGV EMAp) and a social scientist with a degree from the [School of Social Sciences](https://cpdoc.fgv.br/en) (FGV CPDOC). Currently, I am pursuing a Master's degree in Political Science at the [Institute of Social and Political Studies](https://iesp.uerj.br/en/) (IESP-UERJ), where I am writing a dissertation on preference estimation in the Brazilian Congress. My academic background combines rigorous training in mathematics, programming, and social sciences, with a focus on political science and computational social sciences.

I work as a data scientist at [AtlasIntel](https://atlasintel.org/) and do research at three laboratories based at IESP-UERJ: [MAPE](https://mape.org.br/), on the monitoring and evaluation of policies and elections; [DOXA](https://www.lab-doxa.org.br/), on electoral studies, political communication, and public opinion; and [NECON](http://necon.iesp.uerj.br), on the Brazilian Congress. My interests include political behavior, public policy, and the application of data science techniques to social science research. This broadly encompasses the use of machine learning, deep learning, causal inference, and survey methods to investigate political phenomena.

# \faUniversity\ Academic Research Experience

### [MAPE](https://mape.org.br/) (IESP-UERJ) [04/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher.* The objective of the Laboratory for Monitoring and Evaluation of Policies and Elections (MAPE) is to improve academic production on political science, public policies and their connections, with a decisive impact on public debate.

*Technologies.* Python, R, Streamlit, DuckDB.

*Selected delivery.* A Streamlit application that allows users to interact with the `mape_municipios` database, one of the most complete databases with data about Brazilian municipalities.

### [DOXA](https://www.lab-doxa.org.br/) (IESP-UERJ) [05/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher.* The Laboratory of Electoral Studies, Political Communication and Public Opinion (DOXA), coordinated by Fernando Meireles and Argelina Cheibub Figueiredo, runs surveys on the political attitudes of Brazilian voters.

*Technologies.* R, Python, survey weighting and post-stratification.

*Selected delivery.* Analysis of the DOXA survey on how the population of the state of Rio de Janeiro learns about politics, now a working paper.

### [NECON](http://necon.iesp.uerj.br) (IESP-UERJ) [2026 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher.* The Center for Studies on Congress (NECON), coordinated by Fabiano Santos, maintains databases on roll-call votes, party switching, and legislative production.

*Selected delivery.* A technical note that applies spatial models of voting to the 2026 presidential race.

### *Pensando o Direito* research grant (MJSP) [07/2026 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher.* Grant awarded by the *Pensando o Direito* programme of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security (MJSP). Systematic review of the evidence on a set of public security policies for the Legal Amazon, organized around the idea of a qualified entry of the State into vulnerable territories. The review follows the OQF (*O Que Funciona?*) protocol developed at MAPE. Project coordinated by Djane Braz Duarte.

*Expected deliveries.* (i) an analytical report for the Ministry; (ii) an article submitted to a peer-reviewed journal; (iii) entries on the reviewed policies in the [Dicionário de Favelas Marielle Franco](https://wikifavelas.com.br).

### RESA project (UFAC and IESP-UERJ) [08/2025 -- Present]{.date}

*Researcher.* Socioeconomic and environmental impacts of family-based agroextractive production systems in the Chico Mendes Extractive Reserve, in the state of Acre, with an emphasis on what cooperatives change in land use and in household income. Project coordinated by Luci Maria Teston (UFAC), with IESP-UERJ as a partner institution.

*My role.* Quantitative data collection and analysis, and development of the project's public monitoring platform.

*Technologies.* R, Python, Streamlit; INPE deforestation data and IBGE censuses.

*Selected delivery.* A preliminary version of the [monitoring platform](https://mapa-do-desmatamento-acre.streamlit.app/), covering deforestation in Acre.

### School of Public and Business Administration, FGV EBAPE [02/2025 -- 04/2025]{.date}

*Research Assistant.* Digitized and systematized historical election results using OCR and LLMs under the supervision of Prof. [Cesar Zucco, Ph.D.](https://professor.fgv.br/ebape/cesar-zucco)

*Technologies.* Python, LLMs (OpenAI, Groq and xAI APIs), Docling, DocTR.

*Selected deliveries.* Databases with data extracted from historical images, source code, and technical report.

### [CEBRAP](https://cebrap.org.br/) [10/2024 -- 02/2025]{.date}

*Consultant* for the Center for Critical Imagination. Applied OCR and LLMs to social science research, in collaboration with [José Szwako, Ph.D.](https://iesp.uerj.br/pesquisador/jose-eduardo-leon-szwako/)

*Technologies.* Python, LLMs (OpenAI and Grok APIs), Docling.

*Selected deliveries.* Databases with data extracted from PDFs, source code, and technical report.

### School of Social Sciences, FGV CPDOC [06/2019 -- 09/2022]{.date}

*Junior Research Fellow.* Supported by an FGV/CNPq scholarship, I examined Executive-Legislative relations in the early 20th century using qualitative and quantitative methods. Supervised by Prof. [Jaqueline Porto Zulini, Ph.D.](https://cpdoc.fgv.br/equipe/jaquelinezulini)

*Technologies.* R, Python.

*Selected deliveries.* (i) 3 technical reports; (ii) a peer-reviewed article.

## Digital Tools and Open-Source Projects

- **`mape_municipios_dashboard`** (2025)\
  A dashboard to explore one of the most comprehensive databases on Brazilian municipalities, built for [MAPE](https://mape.org.br/).\
  *Joint work with Fernando Meireles (IESP-UERJ).*\
  [[Source code]](https://github.com/mape-iesp/MAPEmunicipios-Dashboard) · [[Access link]](https://mape-municipios-dashboard.streamlit.app/)

- **LGBTQIA+ indicators in Rio de Janeiro** (2026)\
  A dashboard built on the `mape_municipios` infrastructure for the office of state deputy Dani Balbi, bringing together MUNIC, PNS, and Censo SUAS data on the LGBTQIA+ population of the state of Rio de Janeiro, including the territorial distribution of social assistance facilities.\
  *Joint work with Tomás Paixão Borges (IESP-UERJ).*

- **`RelicárIA`** (2025)\
  A platform that combines AI and data analysis to extract and visualize information from historical documents. 2nd Runner Up for Best DH Tool or Suite of Tools at the DH Awards 2025.\
  *Joint work with Danielle Sanches de Almeida (FGV ECMI).*\
  [[Source code]](https://github.com/felipelmc/RelicarIA) · [[Access link]](https://relicaria.streamlit.app/) · [[DOI]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15536372)

- **`BoticárIA`** (2025)\
  A RAG-based conversational AI that simulates an 18th-century apothecary, grounded in historical pharmacological sources.\
  *Joint work with Danielle Sanches de Almeida (FGV ECMI).*\
  [[Source code]](https://github.com/felipelmc/BoticarIA) · [[Access link]](https://boticaria.streamlit.app/)

- **`Quarto-Model-IESP`** (2026)\
  A Quarto template for IESP-UERJ dissertations and theses.\
  *Joint work with Matheus Cavalcanti Pestana (IESP-UERJ).*\
  [[Source code]](https://github.com/felipelmc/Quarto-Model-IESP) · [[DOI]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20819431)

- **`SciELO-Summarizer`** (2024)\
  A tool for extracting and summarizing scientific articles from the [SciELO](https://scielo.org/) database using NLP and LLM techniques.\
  [[Source code]](https://github.com/felipelmc/SciELO-Summarizer)

# \faGithub\ Repositories for studies

Open notes and exercises from the methods courses I have taken.

- [Lego I](https://github.com/felipelmc/Lego-I) -- *Quantitative social science: data analysis, research design, probability, inference.*
- [Lego II](https://github.com/felipelmc/Lego-II) -- *Linear regression models and extensions.*
- [Lego III](https://github.com/felipelmc/Lego-III) -- *Causal inference: potential outcomes, DAGs, and identification strategies.*
- [Survey Research](https://github.com/felipelmc/Survey-Research) -- *Total survey error paradigm, sampling, questionnaire design, post-stratification.*
- [Systematic Review](https://github.com/felipelmc/Systematic-Review) -- *Systematic review and evaluation of public policies.*
- [Introduction to Legislative Studies](https://github.com/felipelmc/Intro-Legislative-Studies) -- *Legislative behavior according to rational choice theory.*
- [Machine Learning](https://github.com/felipelmc/Machine-Learning) -- *Probabilistic machine learning, mixture models, and approximate Bayesian inference.*
- [Deep Learning](https://github.com/felipelmc/Deep-Learning) -- *Foundations of NN, CNNs, LSTMs, GANs, Transformers, transfer learning, and autoencoders.*
